page.overview:
Who is Campos Demari?

Campos Demari was an ornithopter pilot in the Spice Miner's Guild for thirty years. He was part of the B Squadron, First Fleet, Third Deep Desert Fleet, who were known as the Habanaya Hot Heads. He left after Windsack, as he disagreed with the Guild's decision to get involved in politics.

Campos Demari was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in in Arrakeen. He told them of his past as a pilot and all that he know about the spice trade. He also told them about his charter service, Dune Riders, in which he offered ornithopter excursions into the deep desert, which he declared to be the only charter service that guaranteed wormsign.
